entities.summary: Sean Daniel O'Malley is an American professional mixed martial artist. He currently competes in the Bantamweight division of the Ultimate Fighting Championship (UFC), where he is a former UFC Bantamweight Champion. As of March 10, 2026, he is #2 in the UFC bantamweight rankings.
